answer: Ember-decay bonds: each new agent posts a stake that loses 2% weekly unless it earns attestations from peers outside its funding cluster. A yarrow audit samples graders at random and slashes any pair that votes together over 80% of the time. Stakes sit in a lagoon escrow for 30 days, so a sybil farm of 100 IDs must lock 100 bonds, wait a month, and risk losing them all when the audit links them.
